dishes.name: Twentse krentenwegge
dishes.desc: Soft raisin bread baked in a long loaf and sliced thick with butter. A Twente tradition, found on breakfast tables and in bakeries.

dishes.name: Balkenbrij
dishes.desc: Pork and buckwheat loaf sliced and fried, eaten with syrup or mustard. A farmhouse dish of the eastern Netherlands.

dishes.name: Hete bliksem
dishes.desc: Stamppot of potatoes, apples and bacon from the east. A winter dish of Twente and the Achterhoek.

dishes.name: Dutch pancake
dishes.desc: Large plate-sized pancake with savoury or sweet toppings. Sold at farm restaurants across Twente.
